s.note: the talent quest at the country pub where it starts
s.how: Heat 12 frozen party pies as the packet says. Roll 400g sausage mince in 2 sheets puff pastry, egg wash, cut into 16 and bake at 200C for 25 minutes. Serve with tomato sauce in a squeeze bottle.

s.note: home on the mission before the tour
s.how: Rub 60g butter into 450g self-raising flour and salt. Mix in 300ml milk with a knife until just combined. Shape, score and bake at 200C for 30 minutes. Serve warm with butter and golden syrup.

m.note: Sunday at the troops' mess hall
m.how: Roast a 1.5kg topside at 200C to 52C and rest. Roast 800g potatoes and 600g pumpkin. Cook 300g peas. Stir 2 tbsp flour into the roasting tin, add 400ml stock and simmer into gravy.

w.note: a taste of home for the Aussies abroad
w.how: Bake a butter sponge from 125g butter, 150g sugar, 2 eggs and 200g self-raising flour and cut into cubes. Dip in icing of 300g icing sugar, 30g cocoa and milk and roll in 200g desiccated coconut. Set on a rack.

d.note: a hot, humid night in Saigon
d.how: Brew 500ml very strong coffee from 60g dark ground coffee. Put 2 tbsp sweetened condensed milk in each of 4 glasses, pour over the hot coffee and stir. Fill with ice and serve straight away.
